# P31.9 (DEEPEN.5): negative-space peer classes — declared (entity_type, connector) coverage

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.9__negative-space-peer-classes.md` (Round 9 Wave B, manifest
row 150; closes deferral **D-P30.2-1**). Live-verified (`live_verification=true`): measured
read-only before writing, SHA-tagged image built from `git archive HEAD`, `sig-materialize`
deployed by pinned digest via `pin_image_digest` (never `:latest`), hosted coverage run with
class-scoped negative space, and a +0 re-run. Stacked on the P31.8 tip
`devin/p31-8-predicate-registry-legislation-portal`.

## Summary

- **The peer class is `(entity_type, ingest_run.connector_name)` — ADR-115
  (ADR-R9-PEERCLASS).** The P28.4 rule treated `entity_type` as the class and unioned every
  predicate on the spine as "tracked". With every hosted subject typed `deployment`, that
  meant 26,696,184 measured would-be `not_researched` rows (~12× the spine) of individually
  meaningless absences — the reason ADR-103 ran hosted coverage with `--no-negative-space`
  and deferred the fix (D-P30.2-1). Membership now comes from claim lineage
  (`claim.ingest_run_id → ingest_run.connector_name`), no schema change.
- **The policy is declared data.** `inference/src/inference/data/peer_classes.toml`
  (versioned 1.0.0) declares 18 classes — every connector observed on the hosted spine —
  each with a `tracked` predicate set seeded from the connector's measured emit surface
  MINUS per-claim bookkeeping predicates (`matched_keyword`, `content_term`,
  `bill_matched_keyword`, `unmapped_surveillance_tag`) whose absence is an extraction
  outcome, not a research gap. `inference/peer_classes.py` loads and validates it
  (fail-loud on malformed entries, duplicate predicates, or a connector claimed by two
  classes of one entity type). A predicate absent from the declaration is NEVER negative
  space; a subject whose claims come only from undeclared connectors has no declared
  coverage surface — an honest "not declared", never a guess.
- **Measured before written.** Read-only hosted measurement (`sig_read_public`, READ ONLY)
  counted **1,035,351** would-be `not_researched` rows — 25.8× smaller than the unscoped
  rule — per class: dot_511 907,291 · procurement 118,076 · osm 6,548 · flock_portal 950 ·
  france_belgium_procurement 914 · coarse_international 835 · data_driven 255 ·
  accountability 228 · france_belgium_records 166 · state_statute_seed 46 · france-seed 33 ·
  government_mandated_disclosure 9 (atlas, ok_statute, okc-seed, okcpd_policy, pathways,
  records: 0). Byte projection ≈ 0.27 GB (~1.8%) against the live-read 15 GB
  `db-custom-1-3840` disk (4.95 GB database). Committed:
  `docs/build/reports/p31.9-hosted/negative_space_would_be.json`.
- **Hosted materialized.** `ops/gcp/materialize.sh` no longer passes
  `--no-negative-space` (the flag remains as an explicit opt-out). `sig-materialize` job
  deployed on `sig-api@sha256:5dbc7b9a…` (image `materialize-7ba28a404bf1`, Cloud Build
  `1b5df0fb`); coverage execution `sig-materialize-rm7km` as `sig_materialize`
  (INSERT-only) — see run ledger for the final counts and the +0 re-run execution.
- **Vocabulary + invariants unchanged.** Rows are `not_researched` / `searched_by='auto'` /
  `search_method='inference.materialize (peer-class negative space)'` — identical to the
  old rule; append-only `ON CONFLICT (input_digest) DO NOTHING`; named-denominator counted
  quantities untouched (negative-space rows carry no denominator — absences, not metrics,
  SIG-METRIC-008).
- **Docs/memory:** ADR-115 with `## Revisit trigger` + Appendix F row (spec rebuilt,
  adr-index regenerated); BACKLOG BL-057 sources ADR-115; D-P30.2-1 → DONE.

## Tests

- `tests/db/test_coverage_materialize.py` re-pinned to declared fixture classes: class-scoped
  negative space (S1 class-A misses PRED_B; S2 class-B misses PRED_C), **no cross-class
  rows**, an **undeclared predicate never emitted**, a subject claimed only by an
  **undeclared connector yields no rows**, shipped-declaration default produces none for
  fixture connectors, **+0 re-run**, denominated metrics unchanged, no-total CHECK,
  `read_materialized_coverage` round-trip.
- `tests/inference/test_peer_classes.py` (new): declaration loads/validates; every tracked
  predicate is a registered predicate; bookkeeping predicates never tracked; every
  measured hosted connector is declared; canned-rule end-to-end (union over multi-class
  membership; undeclared connector and unclassed entity type produce nothing).
- `make check` 4,233 passed / 3 skipped · `make test-db` 262 passed · check_backlog,
  check_spec_src, check-build-memory clean.
